on mk of x by y
	return {x, y}
end mk

on lab at x
	return x
end lab

set r to {a:1}
set p to properties of r
set {year:yy, month:mm} to current date
set L to {1, 2, 3}
set m to middle item of L
set s to "abcdef"
set t to text 1 thru 3 of s
set t to text 2 thru -1 of s
set t to text (length of s) thru -1 of s
set t to characters 1 thru 3 of s
set q to (s = "") = false
set i to item 2 of (mk of s by "=")
tell (lab at 5)
end tell
set n to -(length of s)
set w to text (offset of "c" in s) thru -1 of s
